description: Canonical adoption contract (B11) — single machine-readable artefact every agent on every bridge must satisfy. Foundation for B12 (repo MERGE nodes), B13 (CI parity gate), B15 (conformance probe), B18 (telemetry), B19 (dashboard), B20 (promotion rule).

contract_version.description: Contract schema version. Bump on breaking change.

required_tools.description: Tools every conformant agent on this bridge MUST be able to call

startup_chain.description: Ordered probes the agent must execute at boot (intent_detect -> rag_query -> reason)

required.description: Whether intent_detect must run at boot

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence threshold for the intent classification

tool.description: Which RAG tool the agent uses for boot-time retrieval

required.description: Whether rag_query must run at boot

tool.description: Always reason_deeply for the canonical chain

required.description: Whether reason_deeply must run at boot

read_only_write_policy.description: Governance write-policy for the agent on this bridge

default_risk.description: Default risk classification for the agent on this bridge

write_requires.description: Gates that must be satisfied before any write executes

plan.description: A HyperAgent / orchestrator plan must exist and be retrievable

approval.description: A store-backed approval token must be present (GOV-7)

signature.description: The approval must carry a verifiable signature (LIN-1911)

telemetry_key.description: EventSpine event-key the agent emits, e.g. "adoption.event.v1"

runtime_probe_fn.description: Canonical probe identifier executed by B15 conformance gate, e.g. "adoption.conformance.v1"

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this manifest instance was minted

hash.description: sha256 of the manifest with hash="" — computed by computeContractHash()
